# Svix

Svix is an enterprise-ready webhooks service that enables developers to send webhooks reliably and securely.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/svix/.

## Actions

- **Create Application**: Create a new svix application.
- **Create Endpoint**: Create a new svix webhook endpoint.
- **Create Event Type**: Create a new event type or unarchive an existing one.
- **Create Integration**: Create a new integration for a specific application.
- **Create Message**: Create a new message for a specific application in svix.
- **Delete Endpoint**: Delete an endpoint.
- **Delete Event Type**: Delete an event type.
- **Delete Integration**: Delete an integration.
- **Delete Svix Application**: Delete an application by its id.
- **Get Application** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific svix application by its id.
- **Get Endpoint** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific endpoint.
- **Get Event Type** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific event type by its id.
- **Get Integration** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific integration.
- **Get Message** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific message by its id.
- **List Applications** (read-only): List all applications.
- **List Endpoints** (read-only): List all endpoints for a specific application.
- **List Event Types** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all event types.
- **List Integrations** (read-only): List all integrations for a specific application.
- **List Messages** (read-only): List all messages for a specific application.
- **Patch Endpoint**: Partially update an endpoint’s configuration.
- **Patch Endpoint Headers**: Partially update headers for a specific endpoint.
- **Update Endpoint**: Update an existing endpoint.
- **Update Event Type**: Update an existing event type by id.
- **Update Integration**: Update an existing integration by id.
- **Update Svix Application**: Update an existing svix application by id.
- **Create Source**: Create a source for message ingestion.
- **Get Attempt Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific message attempt.
- **Get Endpoint Secret** (read-only): Retrieve the secret for a specific endpoint.
- **Get Endpoint Stats** (read-only): Retrieve basic statistics for a specific endpoint.
- **Get Endpoint Transformation** (read-only): Retrieve transformation settings for a specific endpoint.
- **List Message Attempts** (read-only): List all delivery attempts for a specific message.
- **Recover Failed Webhooks**: Recover messages that failed to send to an endpoint.
- **Replay Missing Webhooks**: Replay missing webhooks for a specific endpoint.
- **Rotate Endpoint Secret**: Rotate the signing secret key for an endpoint.
- **Send Example Message**: Send a test message for a specific event type to an endpoint.
- **Set Endpoint Transformation**: Set or update transformation settings for an endpoint.
- **Update Endpoint Headers**: Completely replace headers for a specific endpoint.
